text:
anna_sales: Hey team — kicking off an RFI thread for Tempo Bridge. They want a 4-week POC (private VPC + on-prem HSM), capability matrix, and tiered pricing for embeddings + streaming. Attached is their security questionnaire (tempo_rfi_q1.pdf). Can infra confirm HSM & KMS options and any FedRAMP/ISO references we should call out? Also need a short perf note for embedding throughput (50 qps target) :wave:

claire_se: @anna_sales I can own the capability matrix + written responses. Quick Q: do they need dedicated GPUs or will Dedicated Reserved capacity suffice for initial POC?

david_infra: For a 50 qps embeddings baseline, Dedicated with 4xA10s should be fine for the POC. For on-prem HSM we support PKCS#11 + external HSMs (Thales, AWS CloudHSM) — cert references: ISO 27001, SOC2, and we have a FedRAMP-in-progress note (not full). I'll drop exact cert IDs in a sec.

claire_se: Cool. I'll sketch capability matrix here — short table snippet for the RFI (will expand into spreadsheet):

```
Feature                     | Redwood Offering                  | Notes
--------------------------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------
Private VPC                 | Private (VPC) deployment         | Customer-managed network
On-prem HSM                 | PKCS#11 + CloudHSM integrations | HSM vendor list + KMS routing
Dedicated capacity (POC)    | Reserved GPU pools               | Autoscale + burst options
Embeddings throughput       | 50 QPS target achievable         | ~4xA10, batching, KV caching
Security & compliance       | SOC2, ISO27001, FedRAMP (in prog)| Audit logs, KMS integrations
Rollout controls            | Canary/A-B, fallback policies    | Per-route model pinning
```

claire_se: I'll convert that to the capability matrix spreadsheet and attach.

anna_sales: Thanks. @david_infra — can you confirm HSM vendors list and whether we can provide attestation documents? Customer legal asked for "HSM vendor attestation + KMS flow diagram".

sanjay_prod: For the pricing tiers: propose POC rate (monthly reserved) + production commit tiers. Rough draft: POC discounted reserved capacity at 50% list for first month, then tiered per-token / embedding pricing. Also include optional paid add-on for extended observability retention.

david_infra: HSM vendors we integrate with: Thales Luna, AWS CloudHSM, Entrust (former Gemalto) — we can provide vendor integration docs. Attestation: we can share SOC2 and ISO artifacts under NDA; FedRAMP is currently a status doc only. KMS flow: customer keys flow -> HSM/KMS -> Redwood Private control plane (we never persist plaintext keys). I'll upload a diagram.

ops-bot: File uploaded by david_infra: tempo_rfi_kms_flow_v1.png -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1724569999/tempo_rfi_kms_flow_v1.png

claire_se: Uploaded capability matrix draft: tempo_capmatrix_v1.xlsx -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1724569999/tempo_capmatrix_v1.xlsx. I flagged a few "ask" rows: latency SLAs, retention for logs, and egress rules for their VPC.

anna_sales: Great. Next actions: (1) @claire_se finalize capmatrix + narrative answers by EOD tomorrow, (2) @david_infra attach cert IDs and updated HSM attestation under NDA, (3) @sanjay_prod finalize POC pricing + one-pager on how billing transitions to production. I'll package and send to Tempo.

david_infra: Cert refs: SOC2 Report ID: SOC2-2024-RED-001 (available NDA), ISO27001 Cert# ISO-RED-1123. Uploaded attestation placeholder: https://redwood.docs/attachments/1724569999/hsm_integrations_note.txt

claire_se: Noted. I'll include an explicit matrix row for "attestation available under NDA" and attach the one-pager + sample SOW language.

anna_sales: Awesome — if nobody objects I'll send a draft response to Tempo midday tomorrow. If they push for FedRAMP evidence, we'll escalate to GRC. :thumbsup:

sanjay_prod: Makes sense. For the pricing doc I'll include an example POC SOW with 4-week milestones and acceptance criteria so legal has something concrete.

anna_sales: Perfect. Thanks all. Closing loop: I'll post the final thread link once I send the RFI package.

claire_se: Thanks — ping me if Tempo asks for model quantization guidance or quant tradeoffs; we should offer an optional path (int8) to lower instance counts. :)

anna_sales: Will do. End of thread.
